verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training doc saying users can opt out of model training in Settings at any time, and it documents HIPAA compliance for Enterprise customers. However, the opt-out is described only as a Settings toggle, with no evidence that admins can enforce it org-wide, and SOC 2 posture is not evidenced. Missing for 10: an admin-enforceable workspace-wide training opt-out, SOC 2 attestation documentation, explicit default training-data policy detail, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture

citations.quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.
You can opt out of model training at any time.
Granola is HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers.
